notes: Single-user local app. 'owner' = the lawyer using the app (lock off, or signed in). 'locked' = anyone opening the app while the password lock is on and they have not signed in. Locked must see only the sign-in form on every page, including direct URLs.

features.description: Sign in with the right password; wrong password is refused
KPI cards, upcoming deadlines, risk chart, recent activity, institution logos
Upload a contract, confirm type and title, analyse, see it saved
Accept, reject and edit findings with a note; decisions persist after reload and move the progress bar
Show in text scrolls the contract pane to the finding and highlights it
List contracts with status pills; filter by title, type, status, party
Open a contract and change its status; persists after reload
Upload a second version and compare clauses side by side
Delete a contract after confirming; it disappears from register and search
Timeline and list with 30/60/90 day filters
Keyword search with highlighted snippets; injection-style input is harmless
Preview a report and download PDF and Word files
Change the firm name; persists and appears in the report preview
Delete all data after typing DELETE; register shows the empty state
